verdict.rationale: Galileo's official MCP server lets AI-powered IDEs and agents create and manage datasets and run experiments directly from the development environment, which covers the dataset-creation and eval-trigger steps of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows an agent reading experiment results back through MCP or another API, and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: documented read-back of experiment results via MCP or API, a published API/SDK reference for dataset and experiment endpoints, hands-on or independent corroboration of the end-to-end agent loop.
